features.title: Repository initialization, feature tracker, and agent instructions
acceptanceCriteria: Root tracker has all required IDs and fields.
Agent instructions enforce tracker dependencies and Docker gate.

features.title: Docker Compose configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Compose validates and defines exactly api and web application services with a private network.

features.title: Go backend Dockerfile and minimal bootstrap
acceptanceCriteria: Minimal Go service builds in Docker, reads configuration, serves health, and shuts down gracefully.

checks.command: docker compose build; docker compose up -d --wait; docker compose exec api go test ./...; GET http://localhost:8080/api/v1/health
checks.result: passed: API image built, service healthy, package compiled, health returned status ok

features.title: React frontend Dockerfile and minimal bootstrap
acceptanceCriteria: Minimal React TypeScript Vite application builds and starts inside Docker.

checks.command: docker compose build; docker compose up -d --wait; docker compose exec web npm run typecheck; docker compose exec web npm run build; GET http://localhost:5173
checks.result: passed: frontend healthy, TypeScript and production bootstrap build passed, HTML returned 200

features.title: Container networking and Vite API proxy
acceptanceCriteria: Browser uses relative /api requests and Vite forwards them to api:8080.

checks.command: docker compose exec web sh -c wget direct api health and localhost Vite /api/v1/health
checks.result: passed: both returned status ok; browser client uses relative API path

features.title: Development hot reload for both services
acceptanceCriteria: Host frontend edit is visible without restart.
Host Go edit is rebuilt automatically and response changes.

checks.result: passed: actual React rendering, proxied health, source edit/restoration HMR with preserved window token, Go source edit/restoration rebuilt and health response changed

notes: Native browser host unavailable; verified using Chromium inside Docker instead.
Initial entry-module edit caused full reload; split App into exported component. Cleared stale Vite refresh-runtime module graph with one restart, then full browser gate passed.

features.title: Environment configuration and Docker volume setup
acceptanceCriteria: Environment defaults are documented.
SQLite data directory is backed by named volume and writable by nonroot API.

checks.command: docker compose config --quiet; docker compose exec api id; test -w /data; stat /data
checks.result: passed: environment defaults valid, named sqlite_data mounted, UID/GID10001 owns writable data directory

features.title: Health checks and Docker verification gate
acceptanceCriteria: Docker build, startup, browser page, direct/proxied health, both watchers, logs, and restart checks pass.
No business features start before this gate passes.

checks.command: docker compose build; docker compose up -d --wait; Docker Playwright scripts/docker-gate.cjs; docker compose stop; docker compose up -d --wait; docker compose ps; docker compose logs; docker compose exec web npm run build
checks.result: passed: both builds, startup, rendered React, direct/proxied health, frontend HMR without reload, Go automatic rebuild, readable logs, nonroot data permissions, complete stop/start recovery, frontend TypeScript/production bootstrap build

notes: Docker gate fully passed before starting any business logic.
SQLite persistence across recreation will be verified after SQLite feature integration; no named volumes were deleted.
Native browser host unavailable; actual headless Chromium browser verification ran inside Docker.

features.title: Go backend architecture and configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Configuration validates environment and handlers, repository, and engine responsibilities remain separate.

checks.command: docker compose exec api go test ./...
checks.result: passed: configuration defaults, address/port/origin/CORS validation and bootstrap compile

features.title: SQLite schema and migrations
acceptanceCriteria: Embedded versioned SQL migrations run transactionally and idempotently.
Foreign keys, WAL, and busy timeout are enabled.

checks.command: docker compose build api (Go1.27); docker compose exec api go test ./...; database readiness health
checks.result: passed: transactional idempotent migrations, schema version, foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout, file0600, data survived close/reopen

notes: Upgraded API image/module toGo1.27 because SQLite1.62 requiresGo>=1.26; initial Go1.25 dependency attempt rejected correctly.

features.title: Thread models and repository
acceptanceCriteria: Thread repository persists names and timestamps using parameterized SQL.

checks.command: docker compose exec api go test ./internal/repository
checks.result: passed: thread create/list/get/rename/delete, UUID generation, empty arrays, missing resources and parameterized untrusted name storage

features.title: Thread management API
acceptanceCriteria: Thread list/create/get/rename/delete endpoints return correct status codes and cascade history deletion.

features.title: Centralized request validation
acceptanceCriteria: Strict JSON limits, unknown/trailing field rejection, canonical UUIDs and trimmed thread names are enforced.

checks.command: docker compose exec api go test ./internal/validation
checks.result: passed: strict JSON objects, unknown/trailing/type rejection, 8KiB limit, content types, canonical UUIDs, trimmed unicode names, strict decimal strings and operation/count allowlist

features.title: Basic arithmetic calculation engine
acceptanceCriteria: Add/subtract/multiply/divide use decimal arithmetic independently of HTTP and database.

features.title: Advanced arithmetic calculation engine
acceptanceCriteria: Power, sqrt, percent follow documented semantics and integer exponent bounds.

features.title: Unified calculation endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: All seven operations use one POST /api/v1/calculations endpoint with decimal strings.

features.title: Calculation history persistence and retrieval
acceptanceCriteria: Successful calculations persist original operands, expression, result, timestamp and thread association.
History is chronologically ordered and isolated by thread.

features.title: Error handling and numerical edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: Stable error envelopes cover domain errors, invalid operands, bounds, rounding and malformed requests.

features.title: Tailwind and shadcn/ui setup
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind, accessible shadcn components and Lucide icons are integrated.

features.title: Responsive application layout
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop sidebar/workspace and mobile drawer are responsive and keyboard accessible.

features.title: Calculator display and keypad
acceptanceCriteria: Classic keypad supports string input, operations, clear, backspace and backend-only calculation.

features.title: Backend API client and TanStack Query integration
acceptanceCriteria: Typed API client and TanStack Query centralize requests, mutations and cache updates.

features.title: Thread management interface
acceptanceCriteria: Users create, select, rename and confirm deletion of persistent threads.

features.title: Calculation history interface
acceptanceCriteria: History shows expressions, results, timestamps and useful empty states.

features.title: Result reuse and keyboard interactions
acceptanceCriteria: History results can be reused and keyboard controls work without intercepting dialogs/text fields.

features.title: Loading, empty, validation, and error states
acceptanceCriteria: Loading, empty, validation and network error states preserve input and prevent duplicate submission.

features.title: Backend calculation unit tests
acceptanceCriteria: Table-driven engine tests cover all operations, zero/negative operands, rounding and numeric bounds.

features.title: Backend API and persistence integration tests
acceptanceCriteria: httptest with temporary SQLite covers CRUD, persistence, isolation, cascade, JSON validation and statuses.

features.title: Frontend component and interaction tests
acceptanceCriteria: User-visible frontend interaction tests cover calculator, thread CRUD, history, reuse and errors.

features.title: Docker-based integration and persistence checks
acceptanceCriteria: All operations work through frontend proxy.
Data survives container recreation without deleting named volumes.

features.title: Accessibility, responsive, lint, type-check, and build verification
acceptanceCriteria: Go tests/vet, frontend tests/typecheck/lint/build pass.
Mobile/desktop and keyboard accessibility are reviewed.

features.title: README and API documentation
acceptanceCriteria: README documents architecture, API examples, operations, numeric limitations and intentional authentication exclusion.

features.title: Docker development instructions and environment examples
acceptanceCriteria: Docker-only startup/test workflow, environment variables, watcher behavior and volume preservation are documented.

features.title: Optional production-oriented container builds
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime build targets exclude development tooling and route frontend API requests appropriately.

features.title: Final cleanup and complete verification
acceptanceCriteria: Full verification suite has recorded evidence.
Feature statuses reflect actual verified state and limitations are reported.
